title: Deny order editing without permission
objective: Confirm that order editing is denied without ORDER_EDIT and leaves order data unchanged.
preconditions: A synthetic customer is signed in without ORDER_EDIT permission.
A synthetic order exists with a line quantity of 5.

steps.action: Attempt to change the order-line quantity from 5 to 6.
steps.expected_result: The operation is denied and the order-line quantity remains 5.
